answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a PUF-derived key whose challenge-response entropy is measured under side-channel power analysis, so cloned agents cannot reproduce the same physical fingerprint. Attestation circuits then anchor these keys on a public terrace of epoch commitments, letting peers verify a registration ledge that no single gale of. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
